name: petri
author: coldsoldr
description: petri: a granular micro-loop effect, inspired by the signal flow of a granular micro-loop pedal. The input is recorded continuously into a 1.49 s stereo buffer at 22.05 kHz; one of eleven effects (mosaic, seq, glide, haze, tunnel, strum, blocks, cut, arp, pattern, warp) plays it back through up to eight loop and grain voices; the wet passes a tone section (an envelope on every repeat, a gentle pitch drift, a resonant low-pass, a small space) and an equal-power mix with the untouched dry. Blue time, green activity, white repeats, orange mix; fn + blue effect, fn + white filter, fn + orange space (shift + fn for fine); blue click reverse, orange click hold (latches). The half-rate path follows Mutable Instruments Clouds (Emilie Gillet, MIT).
